name: Global Ensemble Forecast Request Builder Nodes
description: Request-builder flow nodes for a machine-learned global ensemble weather forecast source served as Zarr v3 objects from an allow-listed cloud bucket (typed contracts 1.0). A module cron TimerTick (TICK) enters on 'tick'; plan emits one HttpRequest (HREQ) GET per (cloud-cover array x lead x chunk) whose CONTEXT is the chunk's parse job as ONE size-prefixed $WXF header record (FIELD_ID, model, init/lead/valid time, member, VARIABLE/VARIABLE_NAME, the tile's GRID and TILE_INDEX/TILE_COUNT, CHUNK_DTYPE, CHUNK_CODECS, origin, dataset, SOURCE_URL, licence class/URL, citation), echoed in the HttpResponse weathernext-parser:parse_cloud_chunks reads; cyclone_request emits the tropical-cyclone track CSV GET with a $TCT header record (model, ensemble size, wind averaging period, origin, dataset, SOURCE_URL, licence) in CONTEXT; publish_request turns a storage-ingest IngestResult (INGR) plus the parser's IngestRequest (INGQ) into the dataset-publication POST for the node's loopback admin endpoint, nothing when weathernext_publish_url is unset or the batch was REFUSED. A skipped cycle answers one FlowNotice (FNTC, KIND Skipped, REASON live-access-disabled / cyclone-url-missing). EVERYTHING is node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig (SDS $PIV, one ModuleConfig, read by dotted path): weathernext_live_access is the live switch (default false: no request, no secrets.get, one Skipped notice); weathernext_auth_mode none|bearer|refresh-token (bearer reads the operator's OAuth2 access token from the credential store lane weathernext_secrets_lane through secrets.get - SDS $PIV, raw 'secret' - and places it ONLY in the HttpRequest HEADERS (authorization), never in a CONTEXT record, zeroing it after use; refresh-token is reserved and reports auth-mode-unsupported); the store path, arrays, init time, leads, chunk indices, chunk shape, codecs, dimension order, dtype and grid are all operator-declared because anonymous reads of the bucket are refused and its layout could not be verified (the parser reads the padded chunk extents and the dimension order from the same config). Licence class is decided per (init, lead) from the node clock: valid time at least 1 h old -> Historical, else RealTimeExperimental. The publication POST's BODY an IngestResult (INGR) FlatBuffer naming the stored batch (SCHEMA, PROVIDER_ID, SOURCE_NAME, BATCH_ID, INSERTED / RECONCILED_* counts, ARCHIVED), content-type application/octet-stream, as data-source/nwp-field-source posts it. - a host HTTP API body, not a module contract. No JSON frames between modules and no base64.

sequentialJustification.detail: One method over one control frame: read the node config, make at most a handful of synchronous hostcalls in a fixed order (plugin.getConfig, then secrets.get in bearer mode), emit HttpRequest / FlowNotice frames. No shared mutable state, no worker pool, no fan-out inside the guest. This guest can never spawn a thread, so it compiles the single-thread lane rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.description: Turns one timer tick into N HttpRequest GETs, one per (array x lead x chunk index pair) from node CONFIG, each carrying its parse job in CONTEXT as a size-prefixed $WXF header record (the tile's GRID / TILE_INDEX / TILE_COUNT over the declared global grid computed here; a chunk outside the grid is refused as chunk-index-invalid), or one Skipped FlowNotice when weathernext_live_access is false. Chunk key layout: <base>/<store_path>/<array>/c/<init_index>/<member_index>/<lead_index>/<latChunk>/<lonChunk> with lead_index = lead_hours / weathernext_lead_step_hours. BATCHING: the tick port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE (the compiled runtime drains a node's queue port-blind); a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames". See graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames.

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (module-sdk runtime type TICK); its payload is not read.

outputPorts.description: One chunk GET per (array x lead x chunk), CONTEXT = the chunk's $WXF header record; the bearer token (bearer mode) only in HEADERS. ABSENT when the cycle is skipped.
FlowNotice KIND Skipped (REASON live-access-disabled), emitted only when the cycle is skipped.

methods.description: Turns one timer tick into the tropical-cyclone track CSV HttpRequest GET carrying its parse job (a $TCT header record) in CONTEXT, under the same live-access and auth rules as plan; with no weathernext_cyclone_url configured it emits a Skipped FlowNotice (cyclone-url-missing). BATCHING: the tick port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE; a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames".

FlowNotice KIND Skipped (REASON live-access-disabled or cyclone-url-missing), emitted only when the cycle is skipped.

methods.description: Turns a completed ingest (IngestResult + IngestRequest) into the loopback dataset-publication POST for hostcap/http-request. Emits nothing unless node CONFIG carries weathernext_publish_url - absence of configuration is not permission to publish - and nothing for a REFUSED result. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE; a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames".

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestResult (module-sdk runtime type INGR) from hostcap/storage-ingest.

inputPorts.description: Completed storage-ingest IngestResult for the batch just stored.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (module-sdk runtime type INGQ) the parser authored for the batch.

inputPorts.description: The parser's IngestRequest for the same batch - the carrier of PROVIDER_ID and SOURCE_NAME.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (module-sdk runtime type HREQ) for hostcap/http-request.

outputPorts.description: Dataset-publication POST (BODY an IngestResult (INGR) FlatBuffer naming the stored batch (SCHEMA, PROVIDER_ID, SOURCE_NAME, BATCH_ID, INSERTED / RECONCILED_* counts, ARCHIVED), content-type application/octet-stream, as data-source/nwp-field-source posts it); ABSENT when no weathernext_publish_url is configured or the batch was REFUSED (fail-closed).
